messages:
deploy-bot: scheduled config-only change cfg-2026-04-12-42 for service=inference-router by @ashley
ashley: planning staged rollout, config changes below:
- per-user rate limit: 120r/min -> 100r/min
- request timeout: 8s -> 6s
- routing preference: v2-quantized primary, fallback v1
- batching.target_batch: 32 -> 24
sam: canary proposal: 5% for 20m, then 25% for 30m, final 100% if stable
ryan: small batch size drop might increase token cost, but helps p95. agree?
sam: yes, latency-sensitive workloads here. target p95 < 220ms
lina: avoid 16:00-18:00 PST ramp. suggest start at 19:00 PST
ashley: agreed. rollback criteria: p95 > 250ms or error_rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m
ashley: add guardrail: premium-tenants pinned to v1 for first hour post-final
sam: rollout config I'll apply:
```
rollout:
  id: cfg-2026-04-12-42
  canary:
    traffic_pct: 5
    duration_min: 20
  ramp:
    - traffic_pct: 25
      duration_min: 30
  final: 100
  constraints:
    - metric: request.p95_ms
      operator: <=
      threshold: 250
    - metric: request.error_rate
      operator: <=
      threshold: 0.005
  overrides:
    premium-tenants: route: v1
  params:
    request_timeout_s: 6
    rate_limit_rpm_user: 100
    batching.target_batch: 24
```
ashley: also increasing kv_cache.eviction_ttl from 10m -> 15m to smooth misses with smaller batches
ryan: will keep an eye on kv miss and memory use
lina: add temporary 5m p95 alert to #eng-oncall for the rollout window
sam: added alert: trigger if request.p95_ms > 240ms for 5m during rollout
ashley: short release note: "Config-only: tightened per-user rate limits, lower request timeout, prefer v2-quantized routing for most traffic, adjusted batching target. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with guardrails."
ashley: pinging #support in case users notice slowdowns during ramp
deploy-bot: deploy started cfg-2026-04-12-42 canary=5% at 1729001111
sam: watching dashboards: latency p95, errors, qps, batch distribution
ryan: initial canary traces look ok, p95 ~210ms, errors nominal
lina: :thumbsup: hold before ramp until 5m stable
sam: holding, will post when we ramp
(20m later)
sam: initiating ramp to 25%
deploy-bot: ramp applied -> 25% at 1729002911
ryan: p95 at 25% ~225ms, error_rate 0.12% (within limits)
lina: still off-peak, proceed but watch kv miss trend
sam: scheduling final cutover if next 30m clean
(40m later)
sam: applying final -> 100%
deploy-bot: rollout complete cfg-2026-04-12-42 reached 100% at 1729004850
ashley: updating release notes in docs/releases/2026-04-12-config-only.md
lina: monitoring on #eng-oncall for 2h, will escalate if anything odd
ryan: will file follow-up if cost delta from batch change is significant
deploy-bot: post-roll metrics snapshot: p95=218ms, error_rate=0.13%, avg_batch=20 (was 28)
ashley: closing thread, will open postmortem only if user-impacting incidents occur
sam: :rocket:
